subregion.name: Edge of Reality, north
subregion.summary: The northernmost chambers and twisting passages in the void.

room.title: green rift clearing
room.body: A rocky clearing of eldritch dirt and glowing fungus around a swirling green rift in the ground.

room.title: twisted root bridge
room.body: A bridge of twisted glowing roots suspended over the starry void.

room.title: glowing pod trail
room.body: A dirt trail flanked by glowing pod plants and red rock ledges.

room.title: glowing plant clearing
room.body: A sandy dirt clearing bordered by glowing stalks and ribbed fungal growths over the void.

room.title: twisted root bridge 2
room.body: A massive twisted root bridge arching across the void, with glowing flora along the edges.

room.title: glowing stalk path
room.body: A gravel and dirt path bordered by dark roots and tall stalks with glowing bulbs.

room.title: glowing root bridge
room.body: A narrow stone path resting on thick, glowing roots over the void.

room.title: orange fungus ledge 2
room.body: Dark dirt and eldritch grass on a cliff edge, with glowing orange shelf fungi clustered by the drop.

room.title: twisted tree bend
room.body: A dark dirt path covered in eldritch grass beneath a twisted black tree, beside glowing orange fungus clusters.

room.title: orange fungus ledge
room.body: Dark dirt bordered by shelves of glowing orange fungus along the rocky rim, with star-flowered plants in the shadows.

room.title: star flower clearing
room.body: A clearing of dark sandy dirt and eldritch grass, bordered by tall glowing star flowers.

room.title: glowing flower path
room.body: Dark gravel and eldritch grass bordered by thick alien foliage and glowing blue flowers.

room.title: alien weed clearing
room.body: A patch of dark dirt and alien grass floating above the starry void, bordered by dense blue and orange foliage.

room.title: glowing root span
room.body: Dark dirt and eldritch grass across thick glowing roots suspended above the void, flanked by luminous flora.

room.title: glowing root bridge
room.body: A curved bridge of twisted roots glowing with blue light over the dark void.

room.title: rift stone bend
room.body: Dark sandy ground beside massive stone blocks wrapped in blue flames, with glowing orange pods among the brush.

room.title: glowing root clearing
room.body: Dark dirt and eldritch grass beneath a large glowing blue root arching over stone rubble.

room.title: glowing root hollow
room.body: Dark eldritch grass and gravel under large glowing blue roots tangled along the rock wall.

room.title: glowing tree glade
room.body: A patch of dark dirt and eldritch grass between purple thickets, beside a twisted tree covered in glowing white pods.

room.title: glowing fungus clearing
room.body: Dirt and eldritch grass bordered by rocky ledges and clusters of glowing yellow fungi.

room.title: eldritch grass clearing
room.body: A patch of dark dirt and eldritch grass surrounded by spiky leafy plants and dark rock.

room.title: striped shrub clearing
room.body: Reddish eldritch soil with clusters of yellow blade plants, bordered by twisted trees and glowing striped brush.

room.title: lava fissure hollow
room.body: Dark stony dirt beside a cracked lava fissure, bordered by glowing pod plants.

room.title: eldritch brush clearing
room.body: Gray sandy dirt bordered by thick eldritch brush and glowing foliage.

room.title: lava flow path
room.body: A trail of dark volcanic rock flanked by glowing molten lava.

room.title: glowing root bridge 2
room.body: A broad pathway along a glowing amber root suspended over the star-filled void.

room.title: tangled root clearing
room.body: Dark sandy ground with patches of eldritch grass, bordered by tangled roots and spiky alien brush.

room.title: rock ledge clearing
room.body: Sandy dirt and eldritch grass bordering a broken stone ledge above the void.

room.title: blue root path
room.body: Dark eldritch grass and gravel beside a cluster of glowing red pods, flanked by a massive glowing blue root.

room.title: glowing plant clearing
room.body: Red eldritch soil bordered by clusters of glowing shrubs and broad-canopied trees.

room.title: lava shelf
room.body: Dark volcanic rock bordered by glowing lava flows and jagged black crags.

room.title: twisted root bridge
room.body: A curved, twisted root bridge with glowing veins spans across the dark void.

room.title: glowing tendril grove
room.body: Red eldritch turf and gravel beside a tangled black root structure, beneath trees with glowing tendrils.

room.title: eldritch grass clearing 2
room.body: Wrinkled volcanic rock and dark eldritch grass, flanked by pools of glowing lava.

room.title: lava bordered plateau
room.body: Dark volcanic rock dotted with blue eldritch brush, bordered by glowing lava flows.

room.title: glowing root bridge 3
room.body: Red dirt bordered by star-shaped flora connects to a massive glowing root spanning the void.

room.title: glowing root span
room.body: A glowing root bridge crossing over the void between jagged stones.

room.title: glowing rock ridge
room.body: A narrow path of orange-glowing stone over the void, bordered by alien plants.

room.title: starflower ledge
room.body: Eldritch grass across a rocky ledge over the void, bordered by glowing starflowers and a gnarled black tree.

room.title: starflower clearing
room.body: Dark dirt and eldritch grass surrounded by glowing star-shaped plants.

room.title: amber crystal glade
room.body: A clearing of reddish eldritch grass bordered by glowing star-shaped blossoms and a large amber crystal formation over the void.

room.title: floating stone ledge
room.body: A path of stone blocks suspended over the starry void, bound by thick tree roots.
